nodes.name: Nexora Pay
nodes.description: Merchant payment processing for 1,100 business customers. Runs continuously; cardholder data in scope for PCI DSS.

nodes.name: Customer Digital Platform
nodes.description: The customer-facing web and mobile platform. The commercial front door and the focus of this year's growth plan.

nodes.name: Order Fulfilment
nodes.description: Order capture, allocation and despatch across three distribution centres. Four hours of downtime costs a day of throughput.

nodes.name: Insight Services
nodes.description: Analytics products sold to enterprise clients, built on pooled customer behaviour data.

nodes.name: Corporate Services
nodes.description: Finance, HR and collaboration for 4,500 staff. Invisible until it stops.

nodes.name: Payment Gateway
nodes.description: In-house gateway that brokers card transactions to the acquiring processor.

nodes.name: Checkout Service
nodes.description: Customer-facing checkout and account service. Internet-facing, deployed several times a week.

nodes.name: Order Management System
nodes.description: The system of record for orders, integrated with the logistics partner.

nodes.name: Warehouse Management (Meridian)
nodes.description: A 2009 warehouse platform running on an operating system out of vendor support since last year.

nodes.name: Customer CRM
nodes.description: SaaS-hosted customer relationship platform holding contact and contract data.

nodes.name: Finance ERP
nodes.description: The finance and procurement backbone. Heavily customised, upgraded reluctantly.

nodes.name: Partner Portal
nodes.description: Extranet used by merchants and logistics partners to manage their accounts.

nodes.name: Analytics Platform
nodes.description: The data platform behind Insight Services. Broad read access across customer data sets.

nodes.name: Production Cloud
nodes.description: The primary cloud tenancy. Three years old, grown faster than its guardrails.

nodes.name: Non-production Cloud
nodes.description: Development and test tenancy. Looser controls, occasionally real data.

nodes.name: Container Platform
nodes.description: The shared cluster the digital platform runs on.

nodes.name: Legacy Data Centre
nodes.description: A co-located estate scheduled for closure. Nobody has a current inventory of it.

nodes.name: Management Jump Servers
nodes.description: The administrative route into production for engineers and the managed service provider.

nodes.name: Build and Deployment Pipeline
nodes.description: Continuous delivery into production. Holds deployment credentials.

nodes.name: Backup Platform
nodes.description: Centralised backup for cloud and legacy estates. Last full restore test was 14 months ago.

nodes.name: Identity Platform
nodes.description: The single identity provider for staff, partners and most applications.

nodes.name: Privileged Access Vault
nodes.description: Deployed two years ago for a subset of administrators. Adoption was never finished.

nodes.name: Service Account Estate
nodes.description: Several hundred non-human accounts, many older than their owners' tenure.

nodes.name: Corporate Network
nodes.description: Offices, staff devices and shared services.

nodes.name: Production Zone
nodes.description: The segment holding customer-facing production workloads.

nodes.name: Remote Access
nodes.description: VPN and vendor access concentrator. The route in for anyone not in an office.

nodes.name: Corporate Endpoints
nodes.description: 4,500 managed laptops and the people using them.

nodes.name: Engineering Workstations
nodes.description: Developer machines with elevated local rights and pipeline credentials.

nodes.name: Corvus Managed Services
nodes.description: The managed service provider running infrastructure operations out of hours.

nodes.name: Sentinel SOC
nodes.description: The outsourced security operations centre. Contract renews in month nine.

nodes.name: Acquiring Processor
nodes.description: The card acquirer Nexora Pay settles through.

nodes.name: Lattice Logistics
nodes.description: Third-party logistics partner with a direct integration into order management.

nodes.name: People Cloud (HR SaaS)
nodes.description: Hosted HR platform holding employee records for all markets.

nodes.name: Cardholder Data
nodes.description: Tokenised in most flows. Most, not all.

nodes.name: Customer Records
nodes.description: 2.4 million customer records across three regulatory regimes.

nodes.name: Behavioural Data Lake
nodes.description: Pooled behavioural data. Contractually restricted, technically accessible.

nodes.name: Employee Records
nodes.description: Payroll and HR data for all markets.

nodes.name: Kestrel Digital (acquisition)
nodes.description: The acquisition target's technology estate. Due diligence covered finance thoroughly and technology briefly.
